svg.aria-label: A three-tier parts store feeding an elevator press. The top shelf holds hot expert cartridges with heatsink fins, the middle shelf holds memory sticks, and the bottom vault holds cold cartridges. An elevator carriage lifts one lit expert cartridge toward the press head. The machine stands for PolyStrata tiering in Linger v0.1.9 (Nov 25, 2026): a 125B Qwen3.8-Flash-Next mixture-of-experts model running on a 12 GB GPU plus 64 GB RAM, with rarely used experts on SSD, at 45.5 tokens per second on an RTX 3060 in the vendor lab with simulated tiers; the project has 4,478 GitHub stars.
